gpu_tip: ~52GB total at 128K context. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 5070 Ti) handles the always-on layers, and ~48GB of DDR5 system RAM covers the offloaded MXFP4 experts — llama.cpp's MoE offloading keeps speed close to a full-VRAM fit.
mac_tip: Needs ~52GB — tight on a 64GB MacBook Pro; a 128GB M4 Max or M5 Max gives more headroom.
